summary: Pre-RBI policy day: US mixed on soft private payrolls; bad data now feared (recession) not cheered post banking crisis. SGX ~17,600; RBI seen as no hike or 25bp+dovish. Four straight up days into a long weekend suggests Friday profit booking; IT short covering ahead of TCS results.

events.claim: RBI policy due 6 Apr 2023 with consensus 25bp hike; speaker expected no hike or 25bp with dovish tone
US private-sector jobs data (ADP) came below expectations early April 2023
Speaker sold 17,500PE at ~60, closed near 20; range view 17,250-17,800, monthly 17,000-18,000

lessons: After a banking crisis, weak economic data is read as recession risk, not as relief from hikes.
When VIX and premiums are both very low, buying options beats selling.
quote: Earlier when the economic data comes bad the people will be happy... after few banking collapse... if the economic data is coming bad they think that the recession is coming.

summary: RBI surprises with no hike (25bp expected); Bank Nifty +400 then round-trips negative. Government removed windfall tax on locally-produced crude - policy support signal. VIX broke 12 (~11.8 multi-year low); FIIs +475cr, DIIs -997cr; fifth straight green close.

events.claim: RBI kept repo rate unchanged at 6.50% on 6 Apr 2023, defying 25bp hike expectations
Government removed windfall tax on locally produced crude oil (early April 2023)
India VIX fell ~5% to ~11.8, described as multi-year low
2019 precedent: 'Nirmala Sitharaman candle' - corporate tax cut from 30% to 22% triggered rally

lessons: When both government (tax action) and RBI (pause) lean supportive, dips get bought.
Event-day moves are long-unwinding vs short-covering fights; the true verdict comes days later.
quote: RBI could have very well hiked the rate by 25 basis point, but still they have chosen to wait and watch.

summary: Post-Easter thin session: US jobs data as expected, European markets closed. FII short position in index futures at 82% - historically above 80% marks oversold and rallies followed. IT short covering expected ahead of TCS results; plan: sell 17,200-and-below monthly PEs on dips, new range 17,200-18,100.

events.claim: FII short position in index futures stood at 82% (above 80% = historically oversold)
Nifty bottomed ~16,828 and rallied ~800 points to ~17,600
TCS Q4 results scheduled Wednesday 12 Apr 2023

lessons: FII futures short-positioning above 80% has reliably preceded multi-week rallies.
On result days the tape reflects long unwinding and short covering, not the result's true worth.
quote: Uniformly as and when FIIs had short position over 80 percent markets rallied in the next few weeks.

summary: Sixth straight green close with both institutions buying (FIIs +880cr, DIIs +350cr). Daily rhythm: ~100-point intraday dip then recovery. IT short covering on TCS/Infosys ahead of results; 17,600 support vs 17,700-17,800 call-writing resistance; Thursday stacks CPI + Fed minutes + TCS results.

events.claim: Nifty closed higher for the sixth consecutive session on 10 Apr 2023
US CPI and Fed minutes plus TCS results all land the same night (12-13 Apr 2023)

lessons: Buy-on-dip works only while FIIs are in buying mode; the ~80-100 point daily dip is the seller's entry rhythm.
Bank Nifty post-event round-trips show profit-booking, not reversal.
quote: Every day Nifty falls about 80 to 100 point intraday and then of course after that it recovers.
dup_flag: partial repeat of 1600's IT short-covering thesis

summary: Seventh straight up day expected; India CPI seen below 6% (RBI comfort band 2-6%). SBI's $2B dollar-bond raise interpreted both ways. FinNifty expiry adds volatility. Plan: sell 17,200-below PE on dips, 18,100 CE on rises, always buying a hedge 200-300 points away.

events.claim: State Bank of India plans to raise up to $2 billion via dollar-denominated bonds (April 2023)
Bank of Korea left rates unchanged; China March CPI came below expectations
India CPI expected below 6% - inside RBI's 2-6% comfort band

lessons: Every corporate action has two readings - the market's interpretation is what pays.
Selling options 200-300 points away with a bought hedge caps risk and cuts margin.
quote: Risk management is very very important in stock market.
leaks: I am not a CB registered person (SEBI)

summary: Seventh straight green close; eighth consecutive day of FII buying (+342cr, DIIs -264cr). Kotak Bank jumped 5% on unconfirmed MSCI-weightage news - 2018 Buffett-rumor parallel cited. All five Nifty IT stocks bottom-five. Speaker unveiled a TCS call butterfly (buy 3200CE, sell 3x 3300CE, buy 2x 3400CE).

events.claim: Kotak Mahindra Bank rose 5%+ on unconfirmed MSCI weightage-increase news (11 Apr 2023)
Dec 2018: report of Warren Buffett looking to buy up to 10% of Kotak Bank sent it up 10%+ then it fell next day
All five Nifty-50 IT stocks (TCS, Infosys, HCL Tech, Wipro, Tech Mahindra) were the bottom five performers

lessons: Unconfirmed 'informed buyer' news can be an exit pump - check who benefits.
A 1:3:2 call butterfly (buy ATM, sell 2x OTM, buy far) defines both tails for a result-day view.
quote: Option sellers... always believe in receiving the money from buyers.
leaks: I'm not a CB registered analyst (SEBI)

summary: Calm-before-storm pre-event session: TCS results, US CPI and Fed minutes land tonight; IMF cutting global growth forecasts. HDFC Bank raising ~50,000 crore via bonds. Premiums too low to sell this series - May 17,000PE sale with 16,500PE pseudo-hedge planned; positions to be cut very light.

events.claim: HDFC Bank to raise about ₹50,000 crore (~$6bn) from bond markets (April 2023)
TCS results due after market close 12 Apr; US CPI and Fed minutes same evening; India CPI expected below 6%
IMF cutting world economic growth forecasts (April 2023 WEO)

lessons: Never chase good news - the market will always offer a dip to enter.
Ahead of stacked binary events, cut position size rather than predict direction.
quote: Better to keep positions very very light ahead of lot of events.
leaks: sponsored by taxbeddy dot com / delta dot exchange (TaxBuddy, Delta Exchange)

summary: Eighth straight up; Nifty +1,000 from 16,828 in under two weeks. TCS results mixed (revenue below estimate), Infosys ADR unresponsive; India CPI below 6% was a non-event; US CPI at 5% (from ~6%) sparked a global rally. VIX rose - premiums barely decayed, denting the speaker's non-directional P&L.

events.claim: US CPI fell to 5% from 6% prior (peak ~8.9%) - April 2023 print
India CPI came below 6%, inside RBI comfort band (March 2023 print)
TCS Q4 revenue missed estimates while profit met them (12 Apr 2023)

lessons: An expected-good macro print can still be a non-event - positioning, not news, drives the reaction.
A VIX spike punishes non-directional sellers even in a rising market.
quote: From 8.9 percent now about 5 percent it has almost half.
dup_flag: TCS results day continues from 1605 preview

summary: US whipsaw: CPI beat sent NASDAQ +200, Fed minutes' recession warning took back -300. LEAPS premiums collapsed - speaker booked a large US-market profit. Infosys ADR -2% vs +1% in India signals TCS results read poorly; banks near 52-week highs vs IT at lows. Monthly range 17,200-18,100 maintained.

events.claim: US CPI and core CPI beat expectations; NASDAQ 100 +200 then Fed minutes flagged possible recession later in 2023, NASDAQ fell ~300
Infosys ADR fell 2% overnight despite rising 1% in India - implying a poor TCS-results read

lessons: The Fed talks markets down at highs and talks them up at lows - long-dated straddles monetize both.
ADR moves between Indian close and US open are the cleanest next-day read-through.
quote: As and when markets are higher, the Fed will come and give some hawkish comment... when markets are lower... good comment.
leaks: personal US P&L claim: made more than $20,000 in a day (genericize)

summary: Ninth straight up close (+18) powered by Bank Nifty +500 despite IT damage; long-banks/short-IT the working pair trade. Infosys ADR -7% implies ~10% fall over two sessions; its ~7% weightage alone can take ~90 Nifty points. Broker Finvasia/Shoonya glitch wiped out traders; SEBI weighing an alternate square-off terminal.

events.claim: Infosys ADR fell ~7% in US trade after TCS results; Infosys weightage in Nifty ~7% due to free-float
Broker (Finvasia/Shoonya) suffered a technical glitch on 13 Apr 2023; clients lost 10-20% of capital without trading; SEBI reportedly working on an alternate square-off terminal
TCS and Infosys together dragged Nifty ~45 points yet Nifty closed +18 on banks

lessons: Index-point math: stock weightage x percentage fall = index points - know your heavyweights.
Pair trades (long banks, short IT) monetize divergence without directional risk.
quote: If a stock is falling 7% and which is having about 7% weightage, that alone can take away half a percent in Nifty.
leaks: I tweeted / my social media references

summary: Infosys seen opening ~10% lower per ADR (~-100 Nifty points) after Q4 miss; Friday's heavy shorting invites partial covering. HDFC Bank 'missed street expectation' yet grew profit >20% QoQ - first time post-pandemic; JPMorgan +7%, Citi +3% show US banks outperforming. May caution: Karnataka election May 10, counting Saturday 13th.

events.claim: Infosys Q4 FY23 results missed guidance; stock fell 10%+; ADR implied similar open (17 Apr 2023)
HDFC Bank Q4 profit grew over 20% QoQ - first >20% print post-pandemic, though below street estimates
JPMorgan +7% and Citigroup +3% on 14 Apr 2023 after strong US bank results
Karnataka assembly election voting 10 May 2023, exit polls 11th, counting Saturday 13 May

lessons: A hedged short (sell strike, buy 300 below) caps loss to the spread while keeping the premium.
Results counted on a Saturday mean a Monday gap - carry nothing into it.
quote: Always I go for hedging... my maximum loss is 300 rupees... at least your capital is not wiped out.

summary: Infosys fell 11-12%; Nifty -121 but HDFC twins+Infosys contributed -155 - the rest of the market was green. PSU bank index +3% best performer. Speaker sold Infosys 1200PE at 18, booked at 8. DIIs as value buyers at Infosys' ~20 PE; ITC (+100% in a year) topped Nifty while Infosys bottomed.

events.claim: Infosys fell over 10% (11-12%) on 17 Apr 2023 after Q4 guidance miss
HDFC Bank, HDFC and Infosys together contributed -155 points to Nifty's -121 fall; broader market closed green
ITC nearly doubled in a year, trading at 411 vs ~200

lessons: Domestic institutions buy valuation (Infosys ~20 PE, 3% yield) - that is the dip-liquidity.
When three heavyweights explain more than the index's fall, the trend underneath is intact.
quote: You will never be able to predict the market... better not to time the market... start investing through SIP.
leaks: I tweeted Monday Infosys will open... (social media)

summary: US VIX below 17 from a 20-30 regime; China GDP slightly better. Nifty +1,000 and Bank Nifty +4,000 in two weeks demand consolidation. FIIs turned net sellers - mode check: buying mode = buy dips, selling mode = sell rises. Infosys at ~20-21 PE (historical low) with 3% yield framed as contrarian SIP territory.

events.claim: US VIX (CBOE) fell below 17 after months in the 20-30 range (Apr 2023)
China Q1 2023 GDP came slightly better than expected
Infosys PE ~20-21, historical low, dividend yield ~3%; historically moved 10-20% on results

lessons: FII mode dictates tactics: buy dips in their buying mode, sell rises in their selling mode.
Every crisis (Lehman, COVID) rewarded patient buyers - results-driven selloffs in quality names are the same setup.
quote: Every crisis is an opportunity... Lehman brother collapse came and coronavirus came... people who bought... were uniformly rewarded.

summary: Second day of fall - a sudden afternoon selloff on an unconfirmed media report that LTCG could rise from 10% to slab rates (HNIs ~42%); report said only if BJP returns in 2024. Debt-MF indexation removal weeks earlier cited as precedent. FIIs -810cr; large caps sold, broader market green. Speaker plans to shift major trading to US markets.

events.claim: Media report (18 Apr 2023): government weighing increase in LTCG tax on equities from 10% to slab rates; later denied by finance ministry
Debt mutual fund indexation benefit removed (Finance Act 2023, effective 1 Apr 2023)
STT on options was increased 25% earlier (FY23 budget)

lessons: The only local trigger that corrects India against a good world is government-FII friction over taxes.
Tax trial balloons hit prices even when a year away - positioning, not the law, moves first.
quote: Whenever there was a friction between the government and FIIs... we corrected against the global trend.
leaks: one of my friends told me (genericize)
I am planning to shift major part of my trading to US markets (personal)

summary: Third straight down day; Europe at 14-month highs, Netflix -10% on results. LTCG report denied by finance ministry and IT department - speaker warns denials rarely kill tax fears. Levels: 17,800 this-expiry resistance, 18,100 monthly; support 17,255. ICICI results Saturday the next catalyst.

events.claim: European markets at 14-month highs (18-19 Apr 2023)
Netflix fell ~10% after-hours on weak results (18 Apr 2023), then recovered
Government (finance ministry, IT dept) denied the LTCG-hike media report on 18 Apr 2023

lessons: It is easier to scare holders into selling at highs than at lows - expect air pockets after big runs.
Official denials of tax reports rarely restore trust immediately.
quote: When the governor says everything is normal, definitely there is something abnormal.

summary: Nifty -41 with Infosys+TCS contributing 75% of the fall; banks also wobbled ahead of ICICI results. Reliance best performer ahead of Friday results. FIIs -13cr, DIIs -110cr (negligible). Speaker bought 400 Infosys shares in cash for a covered-call hold; option book hedged (sell 17,800CE, buy 18,000CE).

events.claim: Infosys and TCS contributed ~75% of Nifty's fall on 19 Apr 2023; Reliance gained ahead of 21 Apr results
Results calendar: HCL Tech (20 Apr), Reliance (21 Apr), ICICI Bank (22 Apr), then IndusInd, Axis, Bajaj twins, Maruti, HUL within a week

lessons: Covered calls convert a value buy into a paid wait - premium offsets drawdown.
A bought hedge 200 points away turns a gap-up black swan into a bounded loss.
quote: Whenever I sell I always buy some hedges... in case... black swan event... there will be a limited loss.
leaks: personal cash purchase of 400 Infosys shares (genericize)

summary: SGX +50 signals the third-day-fall resolution: declines typically last three days with shrinking momentum (2% -> 1% -> 0.5%) before a fourth-day recovery. Yesterday's low must hold. HCL results today; Reliance Friday; ICICI Saturday; Axis and IndusInd next week - banks the key sector. Speaker admits panic-shifting 17,500PE to 17,400PE cost him.

events.claim: HCL Technologies Q4 results due 20 Apr 2023; ICICI Bank 22 Apr; Axis Bank ~24 Apr; IndusInd ~25 Apr
FII cash selling on 19 Apr was a negligible 13 crore - pressure pause

lessons: Falls exhaust: three down days with decaying momentum set up the fourth-day bounce.
Panic-adjusting positions at the worst tick converts temporary pain into permanent loss.
quote: If the market is in the uptrend... that profit booking last only 3 days. The fourth day the market has to recover.

summary: Gap-up sold into; Infosys broke its low again but a final-hour recovery (DIIs +800cr vs FIIs -1,169cr) lifted the tape against weak global cues. 200-DMA touched three times in a week - tin-and-hammer warning. HCL Tech beat after hours. VIX back under 12; last-expiry-week gamma makes the speaker close positions and go light.

events.claim: Nifty fell below the 200-DMA intraday for the third time in a week, recovering each time (week of 17-20 Apr 2023)
HCL Technologies Q4 results beat expectations (20 Apr 2023 after hours)
FIIs sold ₹1,169 crore on 20 Apr 2023

lessons: Every touch weakens a support level - the tin gives way on the unannounced hammer.
Expiry-week gamma makes both sides lose in a straddle; professionals roll to next month.
quote: If you take a tin and you take a hammer... fourth time or fifth time it will break.

summary: Bank Nifty's June 45,000CE at ~200 premium with the index ~1,000 below its all-time high implies ultra-bullish pricing - speaker sells 45,000CE and buys 46,500CE (~8% for two months). Tesla's -10% results echo Infosys. Reliance framed as a 2,200-2,800 range trade; Friday short-covering spike of 40-50 points expected.

events.claim: Bank Nifty June-series 45,000 call traded ~200 with spot ~1,000 below the 44,100 all-time high (21 Apr 2023)
Tesla fell ~10% after Q1 results (19 Apr 2023), driving US index volatility

lessons: Compare a far-strike premium to the distance from the all-time high - it prices in the crowd's fantasy.
Big caps live in multi-month ranges: sell puts at the floor, calls at the ceiling.
quote: All time high for Bank Nifty is 44,100... this is 1000 point away from all time high and that is trading at such a good premium.

summary: Fifth straight FII-selling day and the month's biggest (-2,100cr) yet DIIs bought 1,600cr; Nifty closed flat after a ~100-point recovery. 17,600 broken repeatedly - tin-and-hammer again. India VIX keeps sinking, making option selling unattractive; speaker closes the month's positions ahead of results-heavy expiry week.

events.claim: FIIs sold ₹2,100 crore on 21 Apr 2023 - the month's highest single-day selling
Nifty traded at 17,500-17,600 vs 18,950 (Dec 2022) and 18,600 (Sep 2021) - 1.5 years of no progress

lessons: FII selling streaks run 9-10 days just like buying streaks - fade the panic, respect the trend.
A collapsing VIX says: stop selling premium, start standing aside.
quote: When they start selling they will continue to sell for 9 days, 10 days.

summary: Third straight session of gap-up-then-fade; this week differs with Reliance and ICICI results digested as good. Reliance GDR +0.7% caps the upside read. Positives (200-DMA held, catch-up potential) vs negatives (FII -2,000cr Friday, Karnataka election, weak global). Series range 17,400-18,000; Reliance call-ratio position explained.

events.claim: Reliance and ICICI Bank reported good Q4 results (21-22 Apr 2023); ICICI 'ended the correction'
Reliance GDR in London rose only 0.7% post-results, implying a muted 0.5-1% move in the shares
Reliance hit a one-year low of 2,180 two weeks prior, then rallied 7-8%

lessons: A correction has two halves: the price drop and the time spent going nowhere - both must complete.
GDR/ADR reaction to results is a slower but truer verdict than the listing-day pop.
quote: Infosys started the correction... ICICI bank ended the correction.

summary: Nifty +120, decisively above the 200-DMA, breaking the previous day's high despite negative global cues; ICICI Bank alone 25% of the gain, Bank Nifty +500. Speaker's Reliance verdict: 'remove extra from extraordinary' - an ordinary result still paid his call-ratio ~50,000. Last-week gamma warning repeated; DIIs +1,000cr vs FIIs -400cr.

events.claim: ICICI Bank contributed ~25% of Nifty's 120-point gain on 24 Apr 2023; Bank Nifty rose 500+
Speaker's Reliance call-ratio (buy 2300CE, sell 2x 2400CE, plus 2200PE) made ~₹50,000
Bank Nifty ETF position up ~600 from cost (~42,000) while Nifty ETF still ~300 below cost (~18,000)

lessons: Which heavyweight starts a correction and which ends it tells you where the money sits.
Benchmark every holding against its index ETF - divergence is information.
quote: Infosys started the correction, ICICI bank ended the correction.

summary: NASDAQ down 7 of 8 sessions ahead of Alphabet and Microsoft results tonight (Meta, Amazon follow) - the week's pivot. FIIs selling six straight days even into good results. Maruti framed as a 6-year 7,000-10,000 range; call-ratio design shared. FinNifty expiry adds intraday volatility; India VIX below 12 despite big moves.

events.claim: NASDAQ fell in 7 of the last 8 sessions ahead of Alphabet and Microsoft Q1 results (25 Apr 2023)
Alphabet, Microsoft (25 Apr), Meta (26 Apr), Amazon (27 Apr) results due; US Fed meeting the following week
Maruti Suzuki trading ~8,500 within a 7,000-10,000 range for ~6 years

lessons: When the megacaps report, US tech sets the world's tone for the week.
Design ratios premium-neutral; bridge any debit with current-month short options.
quote: Be prepared for a bigger move from tomorrow when the key corporate results come in US.

summary: Opened higher despite Asian weakness; Bank Nifty outperformed until 3-3:30pm FinNifty expiry took 200 points off it in half an hour. HDFC Bank weak on a Singapore-stake report (ADR down); PSU banks outperformed. ITC at 411 (+100% y/y). NASDAQ down 8 of 9 ahead of tonight's Alphabet/Microsoft numbers.

events.claim: Bank Nifty fell 200+ points in the final half hour on FinNifty expiry day (25 Apr 2023)
HDFC Bank fell on a report it would buy a stake in a Singapore-based company; its ADR fell overnight
ITC at 411 vs ~200 a year earlier (+100%)
US Q1: market up ~7-8% but tech up 18-20% into results

lessons: Expiry-hour (3:00-3:30) flows can flip a strong index in minutes - size for it.
A heavyweight moving against the tape (HDFC Bank) is the tell that the sector, not the index, is in charge.
quote: ITC went up to 411 and one year back it was around 200 rupees... more than 100% return.
leaks: I am flying to Dubai today (travel/residence hint)

summary: Alphabet and Microsoft both beat - NASDAQ futures +175 recovering a 230-point fear-driven fall; Infosys ADR ticked positive - IT bottoming. HDFC Bank now the weak spot (ADR down). Doji at 17,800 resistance argues for a trigger before 18,000; 17,700PE's highest OI puts seller-breakeven support at ~17,650. VIX 11.5 multi-year low.

events.claim: Alphabet and Microsoft Q1 2023 results beat expectations (25 Apr 2023 after hours); NASDAQ futures +175 overnight
India VIX ~11.5, a multi-year low, even as intraday swings stayed large
17,700 put carried the highest open interest; strike minus collected premium puts support ~17,650

lessons: Support is where the strike meets the premium collected: 17,700PE writers break even near 17,650.
A doji at resistance means wait for the trigger - do not buy the level.
quote: Those who sold the 17,700 put option would have collected some premium... they will be losing if the market falls below 17,650.
leaks: flight journey from India to Dubai / slept only three hours (travel)
